date.as_written: lasaṃ 504 vaiśākhakṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ budhe. [...] vedābhrabāṇāṅkitalakṣmaṇābde māse śubhe mādhavasaṃjñake ca | tithau murārer vvidhusūnuvāre

notes: Chronogram in verse: vedābhrabāṇa = 504 (veda = 4, abhra = 0, bāṇa = 5) Lakṣmaṇābda. 'parvvapallīsaṃ' likely abbreviates Parvapallīsaṃstha / Parvapallī-nivāsin.
